review.algorithm_assessment: Parity prefix sums generate the exact column recurrence for all positive odd jump lengths and the three allowed destination rows. The finite transfer system has order at most2n+1 including the initial impulse. Berlekamp-Massey over prime30011 recovers this recurrence from more than twice that many exact terms; polynomial exponentiation computes column m-1 in O(n^2 log m), retaining the special starting column.
